blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(1 \times 1 + 2 \times 4 + 3 \times 7 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term kuch factors ka product (zarb) hai, aur har factor ki apni ek A.P. chal rahi hai.
Pehle har factor ki list ka \(k\)th term \(a + (k - 1)d\) se nikalenge, unhein multiply kar ke \(T_k\) banayenge.
Phir \(T_k\) ko kholenge, sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karenge, common factor nikal kar saada karenge, aur aakhir mein chhote \(n\) par seedha jama kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1 \times 1 + 2 \times 4 + 3 \times 7 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[1, 2, 3, \ldots:\ k\]
\[1, 4, 7, \ldots:\ 1 + (k - 1)3 = 3k - 2\]
\[T_k = k(3k - 2) = 3k^2 - 2k\]
Kyun: Pehle factors 1, 2, 3 ek A.P. hain (\(a = 1, d = 1\)), to \(k\)th factor \(k\). Doosre factors 1, 4, 7 bhi A.P. hain (\(a = 1, d = 3\)), to \(k\)th factor \(1 + 3(k - 1) = 3k - 2\). Check: \(k = 2\) par 4, sahi. In dono ka product \(T_k\) hai.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 3\sum k^2 - 2\sum k\]
\[= 3 \cdot \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6} - 2 \cdot \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{2} - n(n + 1)\]
Kyun: \(\sum (3k^2 - 2k)\) ko do sigmas mein tora aur constants 3 aur 2 ko bahar nikala. Phir formulas rakhe aur \(\frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\), \(\frac{2}{2} = 1\) se chhota kiya.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\left[(2n + 1) - 2\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n - 1)}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{2}(2n^2 + n - 1)\]
Kyun: Dono hisson mein \(n(n + 1)\) common hai. \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\) bahar nikala to doosre hisse \(n(n + 1)\) mein se 2 andar bacha, kyunke \(n(n + 1) = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2} \times 2\). Phir \((n + 1)(2n - 1) = 2n^2 + n - 1\).
Dhyan dein: pehle factor nikalna, baad mein kholna; is se hisaab chhota rehta hai.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 1 + 8 = 9\]
\[\tfrac{2}{2}(8 + 2 - 1) = 9 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(1 \times 3 + 3 \times 6 + 5 \times 9 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term kuch factors ka product (zarb) hai, aur har factor ki apni ek A.P. chal rahi hai.
Pehle har factor ki list ka \(k\)th term \(a + (k - 1)d\) se nikalenge, unhein multiply kar ke \(T_k\) banayenge.
Phir \(T_k\) ko kholenge, sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karenge, common factor nikal kar saada karenge, aur aakhir mein chhote \(n\) par seedha jama kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1 \times 3 + 3 \times 6 + 5 \times 9 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[1, 3, 5, \ldots:\ 2k - 1\]
\[3, 6, 9, \ldots:\ 3k\]
\[T_k = (2k - 1)(3k) = 6k^2 - 3k\]
Kyun: Pehle factors 1, 3, 5 odd (taaq) numbers hain, \(k\)th odd number \(2k - 1\). Doosre factors 3, 6, 9 teen ke pahaare hain, \(k\)th term \(3k\). Dono ko multiply kar ke \(T_k = 6k^2 - 3k\) mila.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 6\sum k^2 - 3\sum k\]
\[= n(n + 1)(2n + 1) - \dfrac{3n(n + 1)}{2}\]
Kyun: Sigma ko do hisson mein tora. \(\sum k^2\) ke formula mein neeche 6 hai aur bahar bhi 6, is liye dono cancel ho gaye. \(\sum k\) ke saath 3 ko bahar rakha.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\left[2(2n + 1) - 3\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(4n - 1)}{2}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\) bahar nikala. Pehle hisse se \(2(2n + 1)\) andar bacha (kyunke humne 2 se divide kiya tha) aur doosre se 3. \(4n + 2 - 3 = 4n - 1\).

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 3 + 18 = 21\]
\[\tfrac{2 \cdot 3 \cdot 7}{2} = 21 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(1 \times 4 + 2 \times 7 + 3 \times 10 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term kuch factors ka product (zarb) hai, aur har factor ki apni ek A.P. chal rahi hai.
Pehle har factor ki list ka \(k\)th term \(a + (k - 1)d\) se nikalenge, unhein multiply kar ke \(T_k\) banayenge.
Phir \(T_k\) ko kholenge, sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karenge, common factor nikal kar saada karenge, aur aakhir mein chhote \(n\) par seedha jama kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1 \times 4 + 2 \times 7 + 3 \times 10 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[1, 2, 3, \ldots:\ k\]
\[4, 7, 10, \ldots:\ 4 + (k - 1)3 = 3k + 1\]
\[T_k = k(3k + 1) = 3k^2 + k\]
Kyun: Pehle factors \(k\). Doosre factors 4, 7, 10 A.P. hain jis mein \(a = 4, d = 3\), to \(4 + 3(k - 1) = 3k + 1\). Check: \(k = 3\) par 10, sahi.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 3\sum k^2 + \sum k\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{2} + \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\]
Kyun: Sigma ko do hisson mein tora aur formulas lagaye. 3 aur 6 ne mil kar \(\frac{1}{2}\) banaya, is liye dono hisson ka denominator 2 hai.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}(2n + 1 + 1)\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 2)}{2}\]
\[= n(n + 1)^2\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\) bahar nikala, andar \(2n + 2\) bacha. \(2n + 2 = 2(n + 1)\) likha to 2 cancel ho gaya aur \((n + 1)\) do dafa aa gaya: \(n(n + 1)^2\).

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 4 + 14 = 18\]
\[2(3)^2 = 18 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(3 \times 5 + 5 \times 9 + 7 \times 13 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term kuch factors ka product (zarb) hai, aur har factor ki apni ek A.P. chal rahi hai.
Pehle har factor ki list ka \(k\)th term \(a + (k - 1)d\) se nikalenge, unhein multiply kar ke \(T_k\) banayenge.
Phir \(T_k\) ko kholenge, sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karenge, common factor nikal kar saada karenge, aur aakhir mein chhote \(n\) par seedha jama kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(3 \times 5 + 5 \times 9 + 7 \times 13 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 8\sum k^2 + 6\sum k + \sum 1\]
\[= \dfrac{4n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{3}\]
\[+ 3n(n + 1) + n\]
Kyun: Teen sigmas bane. \(\frac{8}{6} = \frac{4}{3}\) aur \(\frac{6}{2} = 3\) chhote kiye. \(\sum 1 = n\), kyunke 1 ko \(n\) dafa jama karne se \(n\) aata hai.
Dhyan dein: constant term 1 ka sigma 1 nahi, \(n\) hota hai.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n}{3}\left[4(n + 1)(2n + 1) + 9(n + 1) + 3\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{3}\left[8n^2 + 12n + 4 + 9n + 12\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{3}(8n^2 + 21n + 16)\]
Kyun: Teeno hisson mein \(n\) hai aur ek mein 3 ka denominator, is liye \(\frac{n}{3}\) bahar nikala. \(3n(n + 1)\) se \(9(n + 1)\) aur \(n\) se 3 andar bache. Phir khol kar like terms jama kiye: \(12n + 9n = 21n\), \(4 + 9 + 3 = 16\).

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 15 + 45 = 60\]
\[\tfrac{2}{3}(32 + 42 + 16) = 60 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(1^2 + 3^2 + 5^2 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term kuch factors ka product (zarb) hai, aur har factor ki apni ek A.P. chal rahi hai.
Pehle har factor ki list ka \(k\)th term \(a + (k - 1)d\) se nikalenge, unhein multiply kar ke \(T_k\) banayenge.
Phir \(T_k\) ko kholenge, sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karenge, common factor nikal kar saada karenge, aur aakhir mein chhote \(n\) par seedha jama kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1^2 + 3^2 + 5^2 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[T_k = (2k - 1)^2\]
\[= 4k^2 - 4k + 1\]
Kyun: Jin numbers ka square ho raha hai woh 1, 3, 5 odd numbers hain, \(k\)th odd number \(2k - 1\). \((a - b)^2\) wali identity se kholne par \(4k^2 - 4k + 1\).

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 4\sum k^2 - 4\sum k + \sum 1\]
\[= \dfrac{2n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{3}\]
\[- 2n(n + 1) + n\]
Kyun: Teen sigmas: \(\frac{4}{6} = \frac{2}{3}\), \(\frac{4}{2} = 2\), aur \(\sum 1 = n\). Minus sign doosre hisse ke saath rehta hai.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n}{3}\left[2(n + 1)(2n + 1) - 6(n + 1) + 3\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{3}(4n^2 + 6n + 2 - 6n - 3)\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{3}(4n^2 - 1)\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n}{3}\) bahar nikala: \(2n(n + 1)\) se \(6(n + 1)\) aur \(n\) se 3 bacha. Kholne par \(+6n\) aur \(-6n\) cancel hue, aur \(2 - 6 + 3 = -1\). Chahein to \(4n^2 - 1 = (2n - 1)(2n + 1)\) bhi likh sakte hain.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 1 + 9 = 10\]
\[\tfrac{2}{3}(16 - 1) = 10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(2 \times 1^2 + 4 \times 2^2 + 6 \times 3^2 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term kuch factors ka product (zarb) hai, aur har factor ki apni ek A.P. chal rahi hai.
Pehle har factor ki list ka \(k\)th term \(a + (k - 1)d\) se nikalenge, unhein multiply kar ke \(T_k\) banayenge.
Phir \(T_k\) ko kholenge, sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karenge, common factor nikal kar saada karenge, aur aakhir mein chhote \(n\) par seedha jama kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2 \times 1^2 + 4 \times 2^2 + 6 \times 3^2 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[2, 4, 6, \ldots:\ 2k\]
\[1^2, 2^2, 3^2, \ldots:\ k^2\]
\[T_k = 2k \cdot k^2 = 2k^3\]
Kyun: Pehle factors 2, 4, 6 even (juft) numbers hain, \(k\)th even number \(2k\). Doosre factors \(k^2\). Product \(2k^3\), yani yahan sirf cubes ka sigma chahiye.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 2\sum k^3\]
\[= 2\left[\dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\]
Kyun: Constant 2 bahar nikala aur cubes ka formula lagaya. Yaad rakhein, cubes ka jama natural numbers ke jama ka square hota hai.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= 2 \cdot \dfrac{n^2(n + 1)^2}{4}\]
\[= \dfrac{n^2(n + 1)^2}{2}\]
Kyun: Bracket ka square karte waqt upar \(n^2(n + 1)^2\) aur neeche \(2^2 = 4\). Phir \(\frac{2}{4} = \frac{1}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: neeche wale 2 ka square karna na bhoolein.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 2 + 16 = 18\]
\[\tfrac{4 \cdot 9}{2} = 18 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vii) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(3 \times 2^2 + 5 \times 3^2 + 7 \times 4^2 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term kuch factors ka product (zarb) hai, aur har factor ki apni ek A.P. chal rahi hai.
Pehle har factor ki list ka \(k\)th term \(a + (k - 1)d\) se nikalenge, unhein multiply kar ke \(T_k\) banayenge.
Phir \(T_k\) ko kholenge, sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karenge, common factor nikal kar saada karenge, aur aakhir mein chhote \(n\) par seedha jama kar ke check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(3 \times 2^2 + 5 \times 3^2 + 7 \times 4^2 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[3, 5, 7, \ldots:\ 2k + 1\]
\[2^2, 3^2, 4^2, \ldots:\ (k + 1)^2\]
\[T_k = (2k + 1)(k^2 + 2k + 1)\]
\[= 2k^3 + 5k^2 + 4k + 1\]
Kyun: Square hone wale numbers 2 se shuru hote hain, is liye \(k\)th wala \(k + 1\) hai, \(k\) nahi. \((k + 1)^2 = k^2 + 2k + 1\). Phir \(2k + 1\) se multiply: \(2k^3 + 4k^2 + 2k + k^2 + 2k + 1\), like terms jama kar ke \(2k^3 + 5k^2 + 4k + 1\).

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 2\sum k^3 + 5\sum k^2 + 4\sum k + n\]
\[= \dfrac{n^2(n + 1)^2}{2} + \dfrac{5n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\]
\[+ 2n(n + 1) + n\]
Kyun: Chaar sigmas bane aur har ek ka formula lagaya: cubes wala \(2 \cdot \frac{n^2(n + 1)^2}{4} = \frac{n^2(n + 1)^2}{2}\), squares wala 5 ke saath, \(4 \cdot \frac{n(n + 1)}{2} = 2n(n + 1)\), aur \(\sum 1 = n\).

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}\left[3n(n + 1)^2 + 5(n + 1)(2n + 1)\right.\]
\[\left. + 12(n + 1) + 6\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}(3n^3 + 6n^2 + 3n + 10n^2\]
\[+ 15n + 5 + 12n + 12 + 6)\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}(3n^3 + 16n^2 + 30n + 23)\]
Kyun: Sab denominators (2 aur 6) ka common 6 hai, is liye \(\frac{n}{6}\) bahar nikala: pehle hisse se \(3n(n + 1)^2\), doosre se \(5(n + 1)(2n + 1)\), teesre se \(12(n + 1)\), aur \(n\) se 6. Phir kholkar: \(n^2\) wale \(6 + 10 = 16\), \(n\) wale \(3 + 15 + 12 = 30\), constants \(5 + 12 + 6 = 23\).

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 12 + 45 = 57\]
\[\tfrac{2}{6}(24 + 64 + 60 + 23) = 57 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (viii) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(1 + (1 + 2) + (1 + 2 + 3) + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ka har term khud ek jama hai: pehla bracket 1, doosra \(1 + 2\), teesra \(1 + 2 + 3\).
Is liye \(k\)th term pehle \(k\) natural numbers ka jama hai, jis ka formula humein maloom hai.
Plan: \(T_k = \frac{k(k + 1)}{2}\) likhenge, kholenge, sigma formulas se jama karenge, saada karenge aur check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1 + (1 + 2) + (1 + 2 + 3) + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[T_k = 1 + 2 + \cdots + k\]
\[= \dfrac{k(k + 1)}{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}(k^2 + k)\]
Kyun: Yahan har term khud ek chhoti series hai: \(k\)th bracket pehle \(k\) natural numbers ka jama hai, jis ka formula \(\frac{k(k + 1)}{2}\) hai. Is liye \(T_k\) ek simple polynomial ban gaya.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = \dfrac{1}{2}\left[\sum k^2 + \sum k\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\left[\dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6} + \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]\]
Kyun: Constant \(\frac{1}{2}\) ko bahar rakha aur sigma ko do hisson mein tora.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{4}\left[\dfrac{2n + 1}{3} + 1\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{4} \cdot \dfrac{2n + 4}{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)(n + 2)}{6}\]
Kyun: Bracket se \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\) nikala, bahar wala \(\frac{1}{2}\) mila kar \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{4}\). Andar \(\frac{2n + 1}{3} + \frac{3}{3} = \frac{2n + 4}{3}\). Phir \(2n + 4 = 2(n + 2)\) aur \(\frac{2}{4 \times 3} = \frac{1}{6}\).

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 3:\ 1 + 3 + 6 = 10\]
\[\tfrac{3 \cdot 4 \cdot 5}{6} = 10 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ix) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(1^2 + (1^2 + 2^2) + (1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2) + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi har term khud ek jama hai, lekin squares ka: \(k\)th bracket \(1^2 + 2^2 + \cdots + k^2\) hai.
Is ka formula \(\frac{k(k + 1)(2k + 1)}{6}\) humein maloom hai, is liye \(T_k\) ek cubic polynomial ban jayega.
Plan: \(T_k\) kholenge, sigma formulas se jama karenge, common factor nikalenge, aur check karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(1^2 + (1^2 + 2^2) + (1^2 + 2^2 + 3^2) + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

\(k\)th term \(T_k\) nikalein
\[T_k = 1^2 + 2^2 + \cdots + k^2\]
\[= \dfrac{k(k + 1)(2k + 1)}{6}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{6}(2k^3 + 3k^2 + k)\]
Kyun: \(k\)th bracket pehle \(k\) squares ka jama hai, formula \(\frac{k(k + 1)(2k + 1)}{6}\). Kholne par \((k^2 + k)(2k + 1) = 2k^3 + 3k^2 + k\).

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = \dfrac{1}{6}\left[2\sum k^3 + 3\sum k^2 + \sum k\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{6}\left[\dfrac{n^2(n + 1)^2}{2} + \dfrac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{2}\right.\]
\[\left. + \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]\]
Kyun: Teen sigmas bane. Cubes wale mein \(\frac{2}{4} = \frac{1}{2}\) aur squares wale mein \(\frac{3}{6} = \frac{1}{2}\); is tarah teeno hisson ka denominator 2 ho gaya, jo aage common factor nikalne mein madad karta hai.

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{12}\left[n(n + 1) + (2n + 1) + 1\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)}{12}(n^2 + 3n + 2)\]
\[= \dfrac{n(n + 1)^2(n + 2)}{12}\]
Kyun: Teeno hisson se \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\) nikala; bahar wale \(\frac{1}{6}\) ke saath \(\frac{n(n + 1)}{12}\) bana. Andar \(n^2 + n + 2n + 1 + 1 = n^2 + 3n + 2\), jo \((n + 1)(n + 2)\) mein factorise hota hai. Book ka jawab \(\frac{1}{12}n(n + 1)(n^2 + 3n + 2)\) bilkul yahi hai.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 1 + 5 = 6\]
\[\tfrac{2 \cdot 9 \cdot 4}{12} = 6 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (x) Sum the following series upto \(n\) terms: \(2 \times 4 \times 7 + 3 \times 6 \times 10 + 4 \times 8 \times 13 + \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Is series ke har term mein teen factors hain, aur teeno ki apni A.P. hai.
Pehle teeno ka \(k\)th term nikal kar multiply karenge, to \(T_k\) ek cubic polynomial banega.
Phir sigma formulas se jama, common factor \(\frac{n}{6}\) nikal kar saada, aur \(n = 1\) se check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2 \times 4 \times 7 + 3 \times 6 \times 10 + 4 \times 8 \times 13 + \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_n\), yani pehle \(n\) terms ka jama.
Tareeqa: \(k\)th term \(T_k\) ko \(k\) ki powers mein likhenge, phir \(S_n = \sum T_k\) ko alag alag sigmas mein tor kar yeh formulas lagayenge: \(\sum 1 = n\), \(\sum k = \frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\), \(\sum k^2 = \frac{n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{6}\), \(\sum k^3 = \left[\frac{n(n + 1)}{2}\right]^2\) (sab sums \(k = 1\) se \(n\) tak). Book ki properties of summation: jama ka sigma sigmas ka jama hota hai, aur constant sigma ke bahar aa jata hai.

Sigma formulas se \(n\) terms jama karein
\[S_n = 6\sum k^3 + 20\sum k^2 + 22\sum k + 8n\]
\[= \dfrac{3n^2(n + 1)^2}{2} + \dfrac{10n(n + 1)(2n + 1)}{3}\]
\[+ 11n(n + 1) + 8n\]
Kyun: Chaar sigmas: cubes wale mein \(\frac{6}{4} = \frac{3}{2}\), squares wale mein \(\frac{20}{6} = \frac{10}{3}\), \(\sum k\) wale mein \(\frac{22}{2} = 11\), aur \(\sum 8 = 8n\).

Common factor nikal kar saada karein
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}\left[9n(n + 1)^2 + 20(n + 1)(2n + 1)\right.\]
\[\left. + 66(n + 1) + 48\right]\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}(9n^3 + 18n^2 + 9n + 40n^2\]
\[+ 60n + 20 + 66n + 66 + 48)\]
\[= \dfrac{n}{6}(9n^3 + 58n^2 + 135n + 134)\]
Kyun: Denominators 2 aur 3 ka common 6 hai, is liye \(\frac{n}{6}\) nikala: \(\frac{3}{2} \to 9\), \(\frac{10}{3} \to 20\), \(11 \to 66\), \(8 \to 48\). Kholkar like terms: \(n^2\) wale \(18 + 40 = 58\), \(n\) wale \(9 + 60 + 66 = 135\), constants \(20 + 66 + 48 = 134\).
Dhyan dein: itne bade hisaab mein har line ke baad dobara dekh lein.

Chhote \(n\) se tasdeeq
\[n = 1:\ 2 \times 4 \times 7 = 56\]
\[\tfrac{1}{6}(9 + 58 + 135 + 134) = 56 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula ko parakhne ka sab se pakka tareeqa: chhote \(n\) par series ke terms seedha jama karein aur formula se milayein. Dono barabar hain, is liye jawab sahi hai.
